about: An adult male gorilla: black hair with the silver saddle, dark skin.

palette.hair: black to deep charcoal, lit to dark grey on top surfaces
palette.saddle: silver-grey over the lower back and hips, graded into the black
palette.skin (face, chest, palms, soles): charcoal black, glossy, lit to grey on the forms

rules: The adult male skull carries a tall sagittal crest, so the head rises to a peak at the back: geometry, not paint.
The silver saddle is the silverback's signature: paint it as a broad soft band, not a patch.
